colour:3494:107043.note_zh: 「Professional」選項在 Design 與 App 中都被提示框蓋住，因此比對到的是兩邊提示框的藍色，兩者一致；此狀態下看不到選項本身的顏色。

visual:1.note: The tooltip bubble is wider than the Design's fixed 300 pt (about 331 pt, nearly the panel's width), so the text wraps into 3 lines instead of the Design's 4; the Mode tooltip is narrower than 300 pt, so the app sizes the bubble by its text rather than the Design's fixed width.
visual:1.note_zh: 提示框比 Design 的固定寬 300 pt 更寬（約 331 pt，幾乎與面板同寬），文字因此折成 3 行，而非 Design 的 4 行；Mode 的提示框則窄於 300 pt，App 是依文字決定提示框寬度，而不是 Design 的固定寬度。

visual:2.note: Bubble fill (blue #0067E0 in the Design), rounded corners, white 12 pt Regular text and the round bullets match the Design.

visual:3.note: The pointer is on the bubble's lower edge and points down at the Enhancement style ⓘ icon, as in the Design.

visual:4.note: The app places the bubble just above the 「Enhancement style」 heading; the Design's bubble overlaps the top of that heading and half of its ⓘ, unlike the Design's own Mode tooltip, which stays clear of its heading. The app's placement keeps the heading readable and matches the Mode tooltip, so this reads as a slip in the frame.
visual:4.note_zh: App 將提示框放在「Enhancement style」標題正上方；Design 的提示框蓋住該標題上半部與一半的 ⓘ，與 Design 自己的 Mode 提示框（不蓋住標題）不一致。App 的位置讓標題保持可讀，也與 Mode 提示框一致，因此看起來是畫面上的繪製疏失。
